item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"sequence_modeling","rationale":"Reduce causal context length to max(10, floor(0.75*L)) for all four datasets, retaining recent interactions in chronological order. Existing MAXLEN plumbing applies this consistently to training, validation, positional embedding size, saved metadata, and the generated predictor. Preserve all other model and training choices.","edits":[{"find":"MAXLEN       = int(os.environ.get(\"SASREC_MAXLEN\",    \"128\"))","replace":"MAXLEN       = max(10, (3 * int(os.environ.get(\"SASREC_MAXLEN\", \"128\"))) // 4)"}]}],"change_summary":"Shorten the default history window from 128 to 96 interactions across training and inference, with one model per category and the 200-epoch cap preserved."}
